title: Sample Field Guide
summary: A tiny placeholder guide that proves the app shell works before real route content is authored.

stops.title: Orientation
script: This placeholder stop exists so the framework has a runnable guide from the first commit.
Real guides should replace this with researched narration, inline images, local audio, and practical route notes.

stops.title: Deep Dive Placeholder
script: Not every stop needs to be tied to a signpost. Use these segments when the walk has a natural ascent, transfer, or quiet stretch where a deeper lecture would improve the experience.
This is where geology, ecology, construction methods, military logistics, and human stories can breathe.
